course.title: Discrete Mathematics
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A detective has interviewed four witnesses to a crime. From their statements, the detective (15) [CO4] has concluded that
i) If the butler is telling the truth, then so is the cook;
ii) The cook, and the gardener cannot both be telling the truth;
iii) If the handyman is telling the truth then the cook is lying.
iv) The gardener and the handyman are both not lying. Now deduce who MUST be lying? (There may be more than one liar). Use Rules of inference for propositional logic.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
